name: Quillan Salkilld
photo_coverage: 7 photos, all reference-only, all from 2026. Commons has two images of him (Qsalkilld.png, QuillanSalkilld4.png) tagged CC0 by an uploader who credits Instagram and an MMA Junkie article as the source, and one has an open deletion request; their licence is not credible, so they are not used or embedded (they were also rate-limited and not downloaded). Front: ESPN studio headshot. Profile: only the near-profile Perth faceoff (left side) and the three-quarter presser (right side). Body: two ESPN stance shots and the Aug 2026 scale photo. Back: Perth faceoff and the Gamrot fight photo.

face.shape: Long, fairly narrow oval-to-rectangular face, longer than it is wide, with high cheekbones and slightly hollow cheeks below them at fight weight.
face.jaw: Narrow to medium width, clean angle, lean; the jaw line is visible under light stubble.
face.chin: Medium width, a little long, moderately projecting, slightly squared at the tip.
face.cheekbones: High and visible, with shadowed hollows underneath (scale photo, ESPN).
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; the brows sit low over the eyes.
face.forehead: Mostly hidden by curls that fall onto it; what shows is medium height with one faint horizontal line.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium opening, slightly downturned outer corners.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, with a slight angle down at the outer ends; the inner ends nearly meet but stay separate.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown, darker than the sunlit hair ends.

nose.width: Narrow at the top, widening to a moderately broad lower third.

mouth.upper_lip: Mostly hidden under the moustache; thin.
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, neutral to slightly pursed; a wide open grin at pressers.
mouth.teeth: Straight upper teeth in the presser smile.

ears.protrusion: Stand clearly off the head on both sides (front view), partly hidden by curls from the side.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Not clear at these resolutions; the rims look a little thick but the folds are visible. Treat as normal ears with mild thickness.
ears.notes: Large, protruding ears showing through the curls are a recognisable cue.

face.notable_marks_scars: Visible acne scarring (small pitted scars and uneven texture) across both cheeks, most on the cheeks between the nose and ears (ESPN headshot, scale photo). This should be in the skin texture/normal map, not the morphs.

hair.style: Thick, tightly curled hair grown out on top and at the back, with the sides above the ears cut shorter. The curls fall forward onto the forehead and stand up to about 6-8 cm of volume, and the back covers the nape in a loose curly mullet. Same style throughout 2026.

length_cm.note: Lengths as stretched; the curled volume is about 6-8 cm on top.

hair.colour: Chestnut to medium brown, very dark in the shadows between curls and lighter golden-brown at the curl tips (sun-bleached look).
hair.hairline: Hidden by the forward curls in all photos; no visible recession.
hair.texture: Dense, springy ringlet-type curls (type 3a-3b), fairly coarse.

facial_hair.colour: Copper-brown, warmer and a little redder than the head hair; chin stubble is lighter and sparse.
facial_hair.density: Moustache thick and full; stubble on chin, jaw and cheeks light (1-3 mm).
facial_hair.length_mm: Moustache hairs about 10-15 mm, combed down over the upper lip.
facial_hair.shape: Thick chevron/horseshoe moustache: full across the upper lip and turning down past the mouth corners toward the jaw on both sides. With light stubble elsewhere, not a beard.

skin.undertone: Warm pink to peach; fair skin with a light tan and red flush on the cheeks.
skin.freckles_marks: Acne scarring on both cheeks; light brown chest hair down the centre of the chest; light hair on the forearms and legs.

body.build: Tall and long-limbed for a lightweight (183 cm, 190.5 cm reach): narrow frame, long arms and legs, small waist.
body.body_fat_notes: Very lean at the Aug 2026 weigh-in (serratus and lower ribs visible, flat abs); lean with visible abs in the studio shots.
body.chest: Flat to moderately developed pecs, light chest hair.
body.arms: Long and lean, modest biceps, long forearms.
body.waist: Narrow; the clearest V comes from the narrow waist rather than big shoulders.
body.legs_calves: Long, lean legs; defined but not bulky thighs, slim calves.
body.posture: Stands upright and loose, shoulders relaxed and slightly forward, arms hanging close to the body.
body.notable_physique_traits: Long, slim, rangy silhouette topped by a big curly head of hair; this silhouette is what makes him recognisable from a distance.

fight_stance.observed: No photo here shows his striking stance; the only action photo is a grappling exchange.
fight_stance.modelling_note: Long levers: let the arms and legs use the full reach rather than the default compact guard. Treat any guard detail beyond 'orthodox' as unobserved.

tattoos.where: Upper back, centred between the shoulder blades, with the wings sweeping up and over the tops of both shoulders
tattoos.description: Large black line-work bird with spread wings (eagle or phoenix style) and long pointed feathers. From the front only the wing tips show, as a row of black curved spikes on top of each shoulder and trapezius running toward the collarbones.
tattoos.size: About 40 cm wide x 25 cm tall

tattoos.where: Right forearm, elbow to wrist, outer and front side
tattoos.description: Black line-work Celtic-style cross running along the forearm, with knotwork at the centre and pointed ends, a knotwork band near the elbow and black tribal or flame shapes around it.
tattoos.size: About 25 cm long, covering most of the forearm

tattoos.where: Top of the right foot near the ankle
tattoos.description: Small black outline motif; not legible at this resolution.

tattoos_note: Left arm, chest and abdomen are bare. The shoulder spikes in front views belong to the back piece, not separate tattoos.
accessories_seen: Thin silver chain and a steel wristwatch on the left wrist (Aug 2026 presser).

kit.typical_shorts: Studio: black UFC-issued shorts with the tonal grey wave pattern and crypto.com logo on his right leg. Fight night at UFC Vegas 120 (Aug 2026): green shorts. Weigh-in: white-and-black patterned briefs.
kit.shorts_colours_note: Black and grey from the ESPN stance PNG (median and 90th percentile); green is the median of the shorts in the Aug 2026 fight photo (arena light).

morphs_not_in_embed._note: Ear targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (not in mh-manifest.json): large ears that stand off the head. l-/r- are his own left and right.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, moustache, eye colour, tattoos and build; medium for face proportions (one good front, no true profile); low-to-medium for morph values. 7 photos, all reference-only and all 2026. What to watch: (1) The silhouette is the cue: tall, slim, long-limbed body with a large mass of tight chestnut curls with lighter tips, falling onto the forehead and over the nape. A short or straight hair proxy will not read as him; use the curliest, fullest hair asset and tint it #4d332a with lighter tips. (2) The thick copper-brown chevron moustache that turns down past the mouth corners, with only light stubble elsewhere. (3) Acne scarring on both cheeks in the skin normal map. (4) Large ears standing out through the curls. (5) Tattoos: big black spread-winged bird across the upper back with wing tips over both shoulders, and a Celtic cross sleeve on the RIGHT forearm (viewer's left when he faces the camera). (6) Very lean at fight weight; keep the waist narrow. Macro values: ageOldM = (26-25)/65; heightUpM 0.10 from 2*(1.829-1.785)/0.875.
